comment: GENERATED by tools/build_ground_raster.py -- do not edit. The ground of the map as pixels: Natural Earth II 2.0.0 (Tom Patterson), public domain, reduced to a 8 km grid in the map's projection, 12 colours. One letter per cell, '~' water (left to the terrain grid), each other letter a palette index; rows run-length encoded as letter then count, row 0 the north. The coast of 1336 from Brondolo to north of Ravenna: the Po's mouths before the Taglio di Porto Viro, the Valli di Comacchio as water, Comacchio an island town (the historiker, 15 October 2026). (tools/po_delta.py) The coast of 1336 at the Jade and the Weser: the Jade Bight a small bay open to the North Sea, Arngast and the bight's south still land, Butjadingen an island behind the Ahne and the Heete by 1334 at the latest, the Weser an open funnel from Blexen and Lehe, the marsh without woods (the historiker, 19 October 2026). (tools/jade_weser.py) The reservoirs of the twentieth century given back to their valleys, the rivers running through them as lines, the provinces between them meeting on the river (the historiker, 20 October 2026; B118). (tools/stauseen_1336.py)
